items.question: How do I book a super speciality consult?

paragraphs: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH) in Kadavanthra is a super-speciality hospital in Kochi, with 10 departments for complex conditions of the heart, brain, kidneys and digestive system and for cancer. When a patient needs more than one team, our specialists plan treatment together. Every patient gets the same respect and the same standard of care, whatever they can pay.
As a multispeciality hospital in Kochi, IGCH brings together specialist doctors and supporting medical teams to help patients receive coordinated care.

sections.heading: Looking for another speciality in Kochi?
paragraphs: IGCH also provides care through its broad speciality departments and clinical support services. These include general medicine, paediatrics, orthopaedics, obstetrics and gynaecology, dermatology, pulmonology, psychiatry and other areas of healthcare.
Explore our other departments to find the care you need.

sections.heading: Find a Specialist Doctor at IGCH?
paragraphs: Looking for specialist doctors in Kochi? Explore our doctor directory to find consultants by department, view their qualifications and check consultation details.
You can also contact the hospital for assistance in choosing a specialist and arranging an appointment.

sections.heading: Plan your visit to IGCH, Kadavanthra
paragraphs: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital is located at Gandhinagar Road, Kadavanthra, Kochi, and serves patients from across Kochi and Ernakulam.
For hospital appointment booking in Kochi, contact our appointment desk or use the online booking facility.
Please bring your identification and any previous medical reports, prescriptions or scan results relevant to your consultation.
